description: Initial schema creation — all core tables, fields, views, and relationships for the SafeFlow facilities management system
author: system@safeflow.co.nz

changes.description: Core work order tracking table with state machine, SLA, and full audit trail
Properties and buildings managed by the system
External contractors with discipline tracking and insurance validation
Internal property management team with escalation tiers
Complete WhatsApp interaction audit trail with LLM metrics
Escalation event tracking with response time metrics
System error tracking with severity and resolution tracking
WhatsApp Business template registry with approval status
Migration tracking table (this table tracks itself)

rollback.description: Delete all tables from the Airtable base. This is destructive and irreversible if data exists.
steps: 2. Delete each table in reverse order (Schema_Migrations last)

notes: This migration represents the full initial schema. Apply by creating all tables in Airtable following airtable/schema/schema.json, then record this migration.
